import 'package:adele_contract/adele_contract.dart';

part 'owning_backend_stream_contract.g.dart';

@AdeleValue('fixture.stream.entry')
final class StreamEntry {
  const StreamEntry({required this.sequence, required this.text});
  final int sequence;
  final String text;
}

@AdeleService('fixture.stream')
abstract interface class StreamService {
  @AdeleMethod('watch')
  Stream<StreamEntry> watch(String scope);

  @AdeleMethod('read')
  Future<StreamEntry> read(String scope);
}
